changeSet.author: bilous
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO question (quiz_id, prompt, question_type, points) SELECT q.id, 'Mock Question ' + CAST(v.value AS VARCHAR(10)) + ' for Quiz ' + CAST(q.id AS VARCHAR(10)), CASE v.value % 3 WHEN 0 THEN 'MULTIPLE_CHOICE' WHEN 1 THEN 'BOOLEAN' ELSE 'SHORT_ANSWER' END, CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(10,2)) FROM quiz q CROSS JOIN GENERATE_SERIES(1, 5) v WHERE q.title LIKE 'Mock Quiz %';

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM question WHERE prompt LIKE 'Mock Question %';
